On 20 November 2025, Dexmax AI’s DMT airdrop campaign was exploited on Ethereum through abusive token approval flows, allowing an attacker to drain at least $130,000 in user assets after tricking over a thousand users into granting unsafe permissions. Dexmax AI’s airdrop campaign prompted users to approve contract spend permissions without proper controls on approval scope or recipient, enabling an attacker to abuse those approvals and drain funds from user wallets.
